label: conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence
title: GS-depth $\leftrightarrow$ Goncharov period-depth correspondence
html:
Conjecture (GS-depth \leftrightarrow Goncharov period-depth correspondence).

Let \mathcal{H}_q be the substrate convolution Hopf algebra (Frobenius–Hopf substrate) and let G(\mathcal{H}_q) be its sub-Hopf-algebra of grouplikes. Filter G(\mathcal{H}_q) by iterated-integral depth:

  G^{(0)} \;\subseteq\; G^{(1)} \;\subseteq\; G^{(2)} \;\subseteq\; \cdots,
  \qquad
  G^{(n)} \;:=\; \langle\, \exp_q,\, \log_q,\, \mathrm{Li}_2^q,\, \ldots,\, \mathrm{Li}_n^q \,\rangle.

Let \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} be the archimedean realization functor (archimedean realization) and let \mathcal{P}_\bullet \subset \mathbb{R} be Goncharov's period filtration on the algebra of (real) periods. Then:

  \boxed{\;\tau_{\mathrm{arch}}\!\left( G^{(n)}(\mathcal{H}_q) \right)
         \;\subseteq\; \mathcal{P}_n,\;}

and the inclusion is sharp at every depth — for each n \geq 1 there exists a grouplike g \in G^{(n)} \setminus G^{(n-1)} whose \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}-image generates a non-trivial class in \mathcal{P}_n / \mathcal{P}_{n-1}.

Stratification dictionary

Depth n Grouplike at depth n Goncharov class
0 \exp_q, scalars algebraic numbers
1 \log_q \log\alpha, \alpha \in \overline{\mathbb{Q}} (Baker class)
2 \mathrm{Li}_2^q hyperbolic 3-mfld volumes (Bloch–Wigner regulator)
n \mathrm{Li}_n^q weight-n multiple polylogs (Goncharov motivic)

Structural content of the statement

The classical Mikusiński operational calculus on C[0,\infty) takes f * g \mapsto \tilde f \cdot \tilde g under Laplace, turning ODEs into algebra. The categorical analog already in this paper — prop:categorical-laplace-unique, q-resolvent — does exactly this for \mathcal{H}_q. What it does not yet pin down is which algebraic relations on \mathcal{H}_q survive \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} and which do not. The present conjecture supplies the structural answer:

  • A relation R(g_1,\dots,g_m) = 0 among grouplikes survives \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} iff all g_i live in the same depth G^{(n)} and the relation is an algebraic identity in the cellular structure of H_n(q) (provable over \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}]).
  • A relation that crosses depth or invokes a transcendental identity among periods (e.g. the Bloch–Wigner 5-term relation, hyperbolic gluing equations) is an archimedean accident — it holds only in \mathbb{R}, not over \mathcal{H}_q generically.

Surreal envelope

Lift the standard-part map \mathrm{std} \colon \mathbf{No} \to \mathbb{R} to the level of grouplikes. The depth filtration extends:

  G^{(n)}(\mathcal{H}_q^{\,\mathbf{No}})
  \;\xrightarrow{\;\mathrm{std}\;}\;
  \mathcal{P}_n.

Surreal infinitesimals 1/\omega^k sit at depth k as literal infinitesimal scaling factors — there is no recourse to distributions or limits. The "delta at depth n" of graded Mikusiński is the surreal element 1/\omega^n, and \mathrm{std} collapses each layer to its archimedean image. This makes the algebraic core survives mechanism (algebraic core survives) into a quantitative statement: it survives at the depth at which it lives.

Existing depth-2 evidence

The paper already records a depth-2 instance in rem:figure-8-archimedean-illustration: the figure-8 knot, embedded in Bring's surface, has hyperbolic volume 2\,\mathrm{Cl}_2(\pi/3) = 2\,\mathrm{Im}\,\mathrm{Li}_2(e^{i\pi/3}). One \mathrm{Li}_2 factor \Rightarrow iterated-integral depth 2, matching the Bloch-regulator class of the archimedean image. See the explicit canonical witness in conj:bring-figure-eight-depth-2-witness.

Discharge targets

Open. The conjecture is structural (no concrete computation suffices to discharge it), but admits a clean reduction to known period theory:

  1. Inclusion \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}(G^{(n)}) \subseteq \mathcal{P}_n: reduces to showing \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} commutes with iterated integration; for the categorical Laplace transform this is the monoidality result already proved (prop:categorical-laplace-unique).
  2. Sharpness (\mathcal{P}_n / \mathcal{P}_{n-1} non-trivial in image): depth-2 case is the Bloch–Wigner regulator ([bloch2000], [suslin1991]) realised by hyperbolic 3-manifolds. Higher depths reduce to Goncharov's motivic-Galois action on multiple polylogs ([kontsevich1995], Goncharov 2001).

Two related open questions:

  • Cellular vs iterated-integral depth. The cellular GB-depth on Z(H_n(q)) — attributed here to prop:curvature-rank-gb-stratification, though that proposition stratifies by the curvature rank of words and mentions no partition; the max-hook statistic is QOU.BraidKnot.gbDepth, a definition, and the step joining them is unestablished (see docs/audits/2026-08-16-three-gb-filtrations-one-name.md) — (max hook of partition) is a separate filtration from the iterated-integral depth used here. Their precise relationship — e.g. whether amphichiral self-conjugate cells correspond to even iterated-integral depths — is open.
  • Graded Titchmarsh. At which iterated-integral depth does the *_q-product on \mathcal{H}_q first acquire zero divisors? This bounds where the graded field-of-fractions tower \mathcal{M}_q^{(0)} \hookrightarrow \mathcal{M}_q^{(1)} \hookrightarrow \cdots is well-defined, and feeds the operational-calculus mechanism per the Mikusiński (1959) construction.
